# FLX-3506: the database sink will not touch a table it does not manage

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The database sink only ever changes tables it created itself. Every table it creates carries four columns of its own, _flux_synthetic, _flux_run_id, _flux_output_digest and _flux_row, after the stream's declared columns, and it refuses an existing table that lacks them, so a production table that happens to share a name is never appended to, emptied or dropped. It also refuses, in append mode, a table whose columns no longer match the stream's (the contract changed), and, in create mode, any table that already exists. Choose another table prefix or schema, or, for a table the sink created under an older contract, use mode=replace.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3506
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
